discord.title: Discord go-live posts
discord.intro: Optional. Paste a webhook from your Discord server and a short message goes to that channel when you go live. Nobody gets pinged.
discord.terms: Discord is a third-party service and its terms apply to what is posted there. You can skip this: the guide also covers open alternatives.
discord.loadFailed: Could not load the Discord webhook settings.
discord.status.on: Set up: go-live posts go to your Discord channel.
discord.error.unauthorized: The last post failed: Discord refused the webhook token. Paste the webhook URL again.
discord.error.not_found: The last post failed: the webhook no longer exists in Discord. After three such failures it is removed.
discord.error.rate_limited: The last post was rate limited by Discord; it is retried.
discord.error.rejected: The last post was refused by Discord.
discord.error.network: The last post could not reach Discord; it is retried.
discord.url.label: Webhook URL
discord.url.hint: In Discord: Server Settings, Integrations, Webhooks, then Copy Webhook URL. It is stored encrypted and never shown again.
discord.url.invalid: That is not a Discord webhook URL. It starts with https://discord.com/api/webhooks/.
discord.saveFailed: Could not save the Discord webhook.
discord.testSent: Test post sent. Check your Discord channel.
discord.testFailed: Could not send a test post.
discord.removeBody: Go-live posts to Discord stop. You can paste a webhook again at any time.
discord.removeFailed: Could not remove the Discord webhook.
